title: Stop Saying "Very Bad"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very bad". Try one of these instead:
• Terrible: a terrible storm
• Awful: an awful smell
• Dreadful: a dreadful mistake
• Horrible: a horrible day
• Atrocious: atrocious weather

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
